residualRisks.description: The direct Editor and GC artifacts do not declare measurement commits, and the GC filename date differs from its internal capture date, so they cannot be represented as measurements of review baseline 1a0f1eceb2d6c04359e2f868ddd9f99d26a0e713.
The dashboard has zero healthy/current inputs and embeds an older Editor metric snapshot that differs from the direct performance baseline artifact.
AM-001 did not rerun compiler, architecture, critical behavior, Editor performance, or GC gates at the review baseline.
Sustained 30 FPS release acceptance and the separate 60 FPS high-end observation are not certified.
Installed size and absolute peak texture, mesh, audio, graphics-driver, and total memory budgets remain measurement-required.
The complete graphics-tier, Day/Night, static-map, and mip-streaming visual matrix is unaccepted, including two known visual findings.
Mip streaming remains fail closed and unauthorized pending visual, memory, and I/O evidence.
Six generated animation textures retain CPU-copy and residency risk; precision and unload safety are unproven.
Candidate-unused packages remain installed pending isolated import, compile, test, build, and device proof.
Current-map CPU/GPU mesh memory and normalized canonical/chunked/GPU Resident Drawer comparisons remain uncertified.

entryDecision.rationale: The bounded authorities record 107/107 explicit dispositions, zero red architecture/performance gates, and accepted compiler, architecture, critical behavior, Editor performance, and GC closeout groups. The 15 release-only obligations remain explicitly unaccepted and fail closed.
entryDecision.phaseZeroCondition: Later Phase 0 owners must produce exact-commit environment and refreshed gate/dashboard evidence before Phase 0 exit.
